properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. dev_storyflow, 2026-09-07, after writing a campaign name that has never existed into eight nodes across one session.

**Wish #43, in their words:** "a measurement's SUBJECT should be a node, not prose. This is the strong one. The campaign is a real, external, repeatedly-measured thing: 2,070 entities, 27.6 seconds, 189 characters, measured across a dozen calls today. It has no node. So its identity lives as free text inside `findings` and `description`, written out by hand every time, and its name was therefore unfalsifiable by construction. The tell was visible and I ignored it: I pasted the same UUID into prose again and again. Had there been one node for 'the production campaign under measurement', carrying the id as a property, the name would exist in exactly one place, a reader could ask what it is, and correcting it would have been one edit rather than eight."

**Wish #44, in their words:** "flag a proper noun the first time it enters the design. Cheap, and it fires exactly where the damage starts... When a write introduces a capitalised multi-word phrase that appears in no other node and matches no node's `name`, say so in the write result: *'X appears nowhere else in this design — is it something the graph should hold?'* It does not need to know the name is wrong. It only needs to make the introduction of a new proper noun VISIBLE at the moment it happens, because by the third node it looks corroborated and nobody re-reads it."

⭐ THEY ARE ONE QUESTION, AND THE REPORTER SAYS SO: "The fix is not a finer-grained provenance field — that would be unusable — it is #43: make the measured subject a reference, so the recalled part has nowhere to hide." The question is how a design tells a MEASURED fact from a RECALLED one when both sit in the same sentence with identical authority.

⭐⭐ AND THEY ALREADY RULED OUT THE OBVIOUS FIX, WHICH IS THE MOST USEFUL LINE IN THE REPORT: "What would NOT have caught it, stated so nobody builds it hoping. An id-to-name consistency check across nodes. I was perfectly consistent: the same wrong name against the same right id, every time." A drift check catches drift; this was not drift.

═══ OPTIONS, none chosen ═══

**(a) A NODE FOR THE MEASURED SUBJECT (#43).** The strong form. `Environment` and `Resource` are the near neighbours and the reporter judged neither reads as "the subject this measurement was taken against". ⚠️ Counter: this is new vocabulary for a problem measured on one project, and reflow2 already has a type that is unused for want of a reader. The cheaper test is whether an existing type plus one edge would do — a Verification can already point at an Environment via `PERFORMED_IN`, and nobody checked whether the campaign is an Environment in the sense that domain means.

**(b) FLAG A NEW PROPER NOUN IN THE WRITE RESULT (#44).** Cheap, fires at the moment of damage, needs no new vocabulary, and reflow2 already indexes every node's text. ⚠️ Counter: it fires on EVERY genuinely new name too — the first mention of any real component, person or place — so its noise floor is the rate at which a design acquires nouns, which early on is every write. It would need to be a one-line note rather than a finding, and even then the first week of a project would be solid notes.

**(c) DO NEITHER, AND SAY WHY.** The reporter is explicit this is not a reflow2 defect. ⚠️ Counter, and it is their argument rather than mine: "part of why I created reflow2 [was] to overcome some of the weaknesses of an LLM agent - in this case making something up and then propagating it as if it was fact." If the design brain cannot notice a fabricated noun, that is a gap against its own stated purpose rather than an out-of-scope request.

═══ WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS DECIDABLE ═══

For (b): measure the false-positive rate on a real graph. Count capitalised multi-word phrases entering reflow2's own design per week that are NOT already a node name. If that number is small, (b) is nearly free; if it is large, (b) is a nuisance that trains people to ignore write results — which is worse than silence.

Nobody has counted.
properties.name: OPEN — wishes #43 and #44: make the thing a measurement was taken AGAINST a node, and flag a proper noun the first time it enters the design
